title: Codex session's Bash command runner cannot resolve node (exit 127) while PowerShell can
outcome: A Codex session that TermAl hosts on Windows runs the documented one-call launcher command with node resolved, whichever runner it picks. Or TermAl documents and steers the supported runner, so that recorded focused checks don't fail before launch.
acceptance: The runner and PATH source behind the 07:03Z exit 127 is identified and recorded: WSL bash or Git Bash, and whether TermAl's spawn environment or Codex's runner choice causes it.

Either a fix makes `node` resolvable for the launcher command in the runner Codex uses under TermAl on Windows, with a regression or a recorded live check, or the docs/test.md and AGENTS.md guidance names the supported runner for Codex on Windows.
